Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: The Replace Order Message allows you to cancel and replace an existing order in a single message. This is more efficient than canceling an existing order and immediately succeeding it with a new order. Replacing an order always gives it a new timestamp for its time priority on the book. If you wish you simply partially cancel an order and retain its time priority, send a Cancel Order Message instead.

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: This must be filled out with the Order UserRefNum sent on the Enter Order Message or last Replace Order Message.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The replacement Order UserRefNum must be unique and strictly increasing for each OUCH account.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares liable, inclusive of previous executions and Self Match Prevention decremented shares on this order chain. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the replacement order.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Corresponds to TimeInForce (59) in Nasdaq FIX

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display

Field.Name: InterMarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: InterMarket Sweep Eligibility

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Customer order identifier for replacement order

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Replace Order Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: The Cancel Order Message is used to request that an order be canceled or reduced. In the Cancel Order Message, you must specify the new "intended order size" for the order. The "intended order size" is the maximum number of shares that can be executed in total after the cancel is applied.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The Order UserRefNum as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: This is the new intended order size. This limits the maximum number of shares that can potentially be executed in total after the cancel is applied. Entering a zero here will cancel any remaining open shares on this order.

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Cancel Order Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order Message is used to request modifications that will not affect order priority on the book. Since priority of the order does not change, allowed modifications are restricted. Increasing share amount is not allowed and requests to do so will be ignored.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The Order UserRefNum as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The new side to be associated with the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: This is the new intended order size. This limits the maximum number of shares that can potentially be executed in total after the cancel is applied. Entering a zero here will cancel any remaining open shares on this order.

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Modify Order Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Account Query Message
Message.Description: The Account Query Request message can be used when recovering state to request the next available UserRefNum that can be used for identifying new transactions.

Message.Name: Canceled Message
Message.Description: A Canceled Message informs you that an order has been reduced or canceled. This could be acknowledging a Cancel Order Message, or it could be the result of the order timing out or being canceled automatically.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Expressed as nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being (partially) canceled

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The number of shares being decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative

Field.Name: Cancel Order Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled.

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Canceled Message Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: AIQ Canceled Message
Message.Description: AIQ Canceled Message

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Expressed as nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being reduced

Field.Name: Decrement Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares just decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative.

Field.Name: Order Cancel Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled. For an AIQ Cancel message, this value will always be “Q”.

Field.Name: Quantity Prevented From Trading
Field.Description: Shares that would have executed if the trade would have occurred. Depending on AIQ type and the sizes of orders in question the value for this field could either be the same or different than the Decrement Shares field. For “Decrement both” they are always the same. For “Cancel oldest” they will be different if the incoming order is smaller than the resting order.

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: Price at which the trade would have occurred

Field.Name: Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: Liquidity flag the order would have received.

Field.Name: AIQ Strategy
Field.Description: AIQ strategy used on the cancelled order.

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: AIQ Canceled Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Mass Cancel Request Message
Message.Description: The Mass Cancel Request message allows firms to initiate the cancellation of one or more orders that are currently booked at the exchange if they match the criteria specified in the request. If no optional criteria are specified then all orders for the specified firm on the account will be cancelled. Optional criteria can be specified in the Appendage field.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: User Reference Numbers must be day-unique and strictly increasing for each Order Port.

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: This field should contain all caps. Firm identifier for the order entry firm. One logical OUCH account can potentially enter orders for multiple firms in a Service Bureau configuration.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol to mass cancel orders on. Optional, space filled if not specified

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Length of entire optional appendage. Zero (0) if no appendage follows.

Field.Name: Mass Cancel Request Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message
